restaurant.history: Miku introduced its Aburi cuisine to Vancouver in 2008. The waterfront restaurant includes a patio, lounge, sushi bar and private dining room.
restaurant.aburi: Aburi means flame-seared. Controlled heat develops the seafood's texture and flavour, while Japanese techniques meet regional West Coast ingredients.

implementationNotes: Current live HTML differs from cached search results; use this live-page snapshot and date instead of search snippets.
Dinner Sablefish is 48; lunch is 42. Menu prices in this dataset use dinner.
Private-events pricing is separate and inconsistent with the main menu; avoid displaying private-dining prices and direct visitors to the official page.
Display a clear illustrative-photography label when licensed generic or generated images are used. Do not call such images actual Miku dishes or interiors.
Do not claim real-time availability. Date, preferred time and party-size controls can prepare an OpenTable search; confirm only at the official provider.
Dietary labels shown are limited to explicit official menu labels. Do not infer vegan, gluten-free or allergen-safe claims from ingredients.
Kaiseki imagery may illustrate a progression, but course order/names should come from the verified listing and be described as seasonal and subject to change.
This dataset deliberately keeps official menu paraphrases brief to respect source reuse limits.
